task.title: Provide an OS-authorized local recovery preauthorization CLI
task.input: M3-T4 permit persistence rules and existing initial-password script guards/Argon parameters.
task.output: scripts/admin-authorize-recovery.mjs with explicit target/role/reason, hidden TTY password preauthorization, and safe audit.
task.accept: 1) The real CLI runs only under OS administrative authority and issues a 15-minute one-time permit for explicit target, current role, and reason. Reject non-TTY or unidentified targets without records. Output the credential once; audit only actor/target/source/time/reason without secrets. An isolated account with no second administrator and no recovery codes obtains a valid permit (E-12). 2) Optional password reset takes hidden, confirmed TTY input and writes only pendingPasswordHash under existing Argon rules; the original password/TOTP remain unchanged at this point. Keep the original initial-password script's ADMIN/unenrolled/enabled/TTY guards; do not clear factors first to bypass them. HTTP cannot submit pendingPasswordHash (E-75).
